newValue.text: Define STANDALONE_BUILDING_IDS, BUILDING_RESEARCH_REQUIREMENTS, and hasCompletedResearch in buildingData
Update getEligibleCandidates in buildingQueue to evaluate unbuilt standalone buildings against research and level requirements
Update BuildingModal to integrate completed researches and display eligible unbuilt buildings as Build Lv. 1 candidates
Add unit tests verifying unbuilt buildings (Infirmary 2/3, Headquarters 1/2/3) unlock in candidates when research or Hall prerequisites are satisfied
